mapper.select: SELECT id, employee_no AS employeeNo, year, dept_code AS deptCode, employee_id AS employeeId, reuse_flag AS reuseFlag, created_at AS createdAt FROM employee_no_history WHERE reuse_flag = 1 AND year = #{year} AND dept_code = #{deptCode} ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employee_no_history (employee_no, year, dept_code, employee_id, reuse_flag) VALUES (#{employeeNo}, #{year}, #{deptCode}, #{employeeId}, #{reuseFlag})
